::: {.callout-note}
## This map project has been archived 
Center City District has (finally!) created their own interactive map tool. 

You can find an updated map at:
<https://centercityphila.org/explore/sips/>
:::

::: {.callout-tip}
## Web analytics
In 2025, this post received 451 unique visitors in the United States who viewed this post 526 times during the CCD SIPS event taking place between June 4 and August 27.

This is lower than [prior years](#past-years) likely because in 2025 [CCD released their first basic map of locations](https://web.archive.org/web/20250614203828/https://www.centercityphila.org/explore-center-city/ccd-sips).
:::

```{r}

  "project",

))

  "project",
  "2024-06-16-ccd-sips",
  year,
  "specialsGeocoded.Rds"
))

create_table(specials, page_length = 10)
```
